symbols.name: width factor
symbols.meaning: A fixed integer by which the width falls at each recursion level.
symbols.quote: The width falls by a factor $\varphi$ at each recursion level: at depth $d$ the width is $\varphi^{d}$, where $\varphi$, a fixed integer, is that factor.

relations.quote: Fixed-tape integer multiplication with a power saving is a deterministic algorithm that runs on one [Fixed-tape machine model](fixed-tape-model.md) and multiplies two $n$-bit integers exactly.
It achieves a [Power saving in the logarithmic factor](power-saving.md), which puts its time below $n\log n$ by a power of $\lg n$.

relations.predicate: carries out its address rearrangements by
relations.quote: It carries out its address rearrangements by [Fast interchange of address chunks](tape-interchange.md), which swaps two equal-width address fields of width $u$.

relations.predicate: is built from simultaneous layers of
relations.quote: Each transform is built from simultaneous layers of [Simultaneous butterfly layer H₀](butterfly-layer.md) on polynomial records.
It computes its transforms by a [Synthetic polynomial transform](synthetic-transform.md) over $\mathbb C[y]/(y^r+1)$.
It rewrites its prime-length transforms by [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md).
It reduces the middle transform by [Bluestein's chirp identity](bluestein.md).

relations.predicate: places the coefficients on axes by
relations.quote: It places the coefficients on axes by the [Chinese-remainder axis map](crt-axis-map.md).
It reduces multiplication to convolution through [Radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md), with $\lceil n/b\rceil$ digits per input.
It packs signed coefficients by [Signed coefficient packing](signed-packing.md), so that polynomial products become integer products.
It computes its shorter products by the [Established fast multiplier](multiplier-subroutine.md), used as a black box.

relations.predicate: recovers the exact binary product by
relations.quote: It recovers the exact binary product by [Exact recovery by rounding and carries](exact-recovery.md).
